summary: Assemble colored rectangular sprites like puzzle pieces using the grey-cornered orange block as the anchor, fitting other sprites by matching their edge positions.
src: colored rectangular sprites without grey corner marker s
dst: anchor sprite (orange block with grey corner pixel) or previously attached sprites d
match_cond: edge(s) aligns_with open_edge(d) such that union forms contiguous_tiled_rectangle
multi_step: repeat merge until all sprites assembled into single rectangle
notes: The grey corner pixel identifies the anchor sprite and determines output orientation (grey stays at top-left corner). Each sprite is a solid colored rectangle; they tile together to form a complete rectangular output.
